rooms.label: Alchemy laboratory
rooms.reads_as: an alchemist's laboratory: a brick furnace on the far wall, work benches crowded with coloured flasks and jars along the walls, a copper still, a cauldron of green brew, shelves of bottles

rooms.label: Library & study
rooms.reads_as: a wizard's study or library: walls of untidy bookcases, a writing desk before them, a great open book on a lectern, an armillary sphere, scrolls, books piled on the floor

rooms.label: Summoning chamber
rooms.reads_as: a summoning or ritual chamber: a large circle drawn in the middle of the floor ringed by tall candles, crystal-topped pylons toward the corners, a book on a lectern between two braziers, no windows

rooms.label: Observatory
rooms.reads_as: an observatory: a great brass telescope in the middle of the floor on an inlaid star chart, an armillary sphere and an orrery, a table of charts

rooms.label: Scrying room
rooms.reads_as: a scrying or fortune-telling room: a round stone basin in the middle of the floor, a large crystal ball on a pedestal, a standing mirror, cushions and candles, no windows

rooms.label: Potion store
rooms.reads_as: a potion or reagent store: shelves packed with coloured bottles and jars on every wall, a cabinet of small drawers, crates and demijohns on the floor

rooms.label: Apothecary shop
rooms.reads_as: an apothecary or potion shop: a long counter with a scale and jars across the room, a wall of small drawers and shelves of bottles behind it, a bench for customers, a shop window

rooms.label: Wizard's bedchamber
rooms.reads_as: a wizard's bedroom: a curtained four-poster bed in purple, a robe and pointed hat on a stand beside it, a trunk, a bookcase, a bird perch

rooms.label: Familiars' menagerie
rooms.reads_as: a menagerie, aviary or animal room: a bare perch tree in the middle, birdcages, hutches and a planted tank round the walls, a huge egg in a nest, feed sacks, straw on the floor

rooms.label: Tower stair
rooms.reads_as: a stair hall or tower landing: a stone spiral staircase in the corner, torches, a bust or a bench

rooms.label: Enchanter's workshop
rooms.reads_as: an enchanter's workshop or portal room: a free-standing stone archway on the far wall between two crystal pylons, a heavy table with a crystal before it, crystal clusters, a rack of staves
